basic_info.description: Seller will credit $175K for 5 YEARS of HOA DUES! Sophisticated & spacious living at The Montaire, a luxury 20-unit building at the crest of Nob Hill featuring a glamorous lobby, 2-car deeded parking and 24-hour doorman service with enhanced video-monitored security.This bright, airy and quiet condominium residence features an extra-large living room/dining space with fireplace, bordered by a wall of windows overlooking a park-like setting, as well as a gourmet chef kitchen with granite counters, stainless steel appliances and breakfast area with lovely greenery outlooks. Two lovely bedrooms enjoy unique views of the exquisite Lake Como-esque trompe-l'oeil mural in the building's courtyard with a glimpse of the Bay and Russian Hill as a backdrop- a touch of Italy in the midst of the City!
